Apple publishes first images of three alleged Home accessories it developed for LG

Apple publishes first images of three alleged Home accessories it developed for LG

The rumored major home product overhaul is said to launch next week. The company will introduce a new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini, as well as an entirely new product category we've been calling 'HomePad'.

But yesterday's Bloomberg report revealed yet another chapter in the Apple home saga. The company has partnered with LG to develop new home accessories that will be sold under the LG brand.

These accessories reportedly include a smart door lock, thermostat, temperature sensor, video doorbell, indoor camera, outdoor camera, and a floodlight camera.

Now leaker pdfu has shared the first images of three of these products today: a smart lock, a smart thermostat, and a temperature sensor.

Top comment by elgipsy

Speaking of thermostats, Apple should have acquired Nest before Google did

pdfu's X post also included new details about these products.

For example, the smart deadbolt features a keypad with a rotating dial, and includes settings like 'backlit keypad ring, door ajar audio alert, and lock volume', as well as support for auto-unlock and more.

Mark Gurman believes these new products won't ship as quickly as Apple's new HomePod and Apple TV. However, it's still very possible Apple mentions them at next week's event.

What do you think of these Home accessories designed by Apple and sold under the LG brand? Drop your thoughts in the comments.

Best Apple Home Accessories

  • eufy 4K camera with HomeKit Secure Video support
  • Aqara smart lock with Apple Home Key and UWB
  • HomeKit garage door opener
  • HomeKit smart plug 4-pack
  • Aqara smart thermostat with adaptive temperature
